title: 1 in 7 Americans Has Unclaimed Money Waiting
hook: 1 in 7 Americans has unclaimed money waiting.
closing: Search your state database for free, because the missing money could be yours.
question: Have you checked for unclaimed money?

segments.say: California holds 15 billion dollars in unclaimed money, cash that still belongs to ordinary people.
States returned 4.49 billion dollars last year, leaving most unclaimed money waiting for its owners.
About 1 in 7 Americans has unclaimed money waiting, so checking free state databases could pay off.
